NBL Rosetta Seasons Current

Source: R/nbl_rosetta.R
nbl_rosetta_seasons_current.Rd

The season in progress (empty between seasons: hoopR_no_data).

Endpoint: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/{org}/seasons/current

Usage

nbl_rosetta_seasons_current(org = "nbl")

Arguments

org

(character default "nbl"): Organisation: nbl (men's NBL), wnbl (women's) or nbl1 (the second tier, men's and women's conferences). One of "nbl", "wnbl", "nbl1".

Value

A hoopR_data tibble (one row: the season in progress):

col_nametypedescription
orgcharacterOrganisation the row belongs to: nbl, wnbl or nbl1. From the row's competition, else from the request.
season_idcharacterDataCore season id (UUID v1); accepted as {season_id}.
rosetta_season_idcharacterRosetta season id (UUID v4; v5 on NBL1); the {season_id} route key.
namecharacterSeason name as Rosetta spells it (NBL26, WNBL 2024/25); names drift, key on season_year.
season_yearintegerRosetta's year of the season: the START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99 (2025 = 2025-26), the calendar year for NBL1 and the 1979-1997 winter seasons. See season_end_year for the sdv key.
season_typecharacterSeason type: regular (includes finals), preseason, in_season (cups, blitz, exhibition), test.
start_datecharacterFirst day of the season, ISO date-time without offset.
end_datecharacterLast day of the season, ISO date-time without offset; null on older seasons.
competition_namecharacterName of the competition the season belongs to (e.g. NBL).
competition_age_groupcharacterUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
next_match_start_datetimecharacterTip-off of the season's next match, UTC; null when none.
season_end_yearintegersdv season key: the END year of the season (2026 = 2025-26), derived from season_year (a START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99, a calendar year for NBL1 and the 1979-1997 winter seasons; year 1998 is split on the start date). Where the body carries no year it is the season asked for.

Columns the body adds beyond these follow, in body order (sportsdataverse-py keeps them too).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in nbl_rosetta_seasons().

See also

Other NBL Rosetta Functions: nbl_rosetta_match(), nbl_rosetta_match_by_id(), nbl_rosetta_match_pbp(), nbl_rosetta_match_player_box(), nbl_rosetta_match_player_period_box(), nbl_rosetta_match_team_box(), nbl_rosetta_matches(), nbl_rosetta_next_match(), nbl_rosetta_next_match_team(), nbl_rosetta_next_matches(), nbl_rosetta_outcomes(), nbl_rosetta_player_game_log(), nbl_rosetta_player_stats(), nbl_rosetta_players(), nbl_rosetta_seasons(), nbl_rosetta_standings(), nbl_rosetta_stats_leaders(), nbl_rosetta_team_players(), nbl_rosetta_team_stats(), nbl_rosetta_team_stats_leaders(), nbl_rosetta_teams()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(nbl_rosetta_seasons_current(org = "nbl"))
#> ── NBL Rosetta seasons_current from prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au ───── hoopR 3.2.0 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-11-01 20:48:22 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 12
#>   org   season_id     rosetta_season_id name  season_year season_type start_date
#>   <chr> <chr>         <chr>             <chr>       <int> <chr>       <chr>     
#> 1 nbl   1b041b7b-3dd… 67d4a190-40bc-4b… NBL27        2026 regular     2026-09-1…
#> # ℹ 5 more variables: end_date <chr>, competition_name <chr>,
#> #   competition_age_group <chr>, next_match_start_datetime <chr>,
#> #   season_end_year <int>
# }
